evidence: Touches AddrMan connection tracking in src/addrman.cpp and src/addrman_impl.h, and carries the P2P label.
rationale: Prevents valid remote peers on alternate networks like Tor or IPv6 from being marked terrible and dropped when local connectivity issues arise. Because `m_last_good` is global, successful IPv4 handshakes currently allow failed attempts on other unreachable networks to penalize remote addresses; stratospher notes 'this is what m_last_good is ideally supposed to be doing'.
